usedFor: New or changed HubSpot deals post to Slack with buttons for the team to act on.

bestTemplate.name: “When a deal is created or updated” in HubSpot, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Buttons or a form let the team approve in place, which a plain post cannot.

watchOut: The deal trigger fires on updates, so one HubSpot deal can post twice, and posts need approval.
